--[[
	WidgetRows  -  one builder per row type of the Properties panel, and buildTypeSection, which
	lays a type's sections and rows out from its row definitions.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau after WidgetSections; receives the shared W table and adds
	buildTypeSection to it.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Parent.PropertyCatalog)
local BuildPacer = require(script.Parent.BuildPacer)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addListLayout = W.addCorner, W.addListLayout

	-- Outer type-section order (the rig types used to tie at LayoutOrder 3, leaving their order to chance).
	local TYPE_ORDER = {
		Meshes = 0, Beams = 1, Lights = 2, Highlights = 3, Trails = 4, BeamNatives = 5, TrailEmitters = 6,
		Lightnings = 7, ["Camera Shakes"] = 8, Rocks = 9, Ropes = 10, Distortions = 11, Attachments = 12, Models = 13,
		Particles = 14, Blurs = 15, Blooms = 16, ColorCorrections = 17, Atmospheres = 18, ImageLabels = 19, Sounds = 20,
		Containers = 21, Forces = 22, Reactors = 23,
	}

	-- Row type dispatch table for buildTypeSection (replaces 130-line if-elseif chain)
	local ROW_BUILDERS = {}
	ROW_BUILDERS.select = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}; W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local btn, frame, selLbl, dotsBtn = W.makeSelectButton(d.key, nil, d.color)
			frame.Parent = p; r[d.key].graphBtn = btn; r[d.key].selectLabel = selLbl; r[d.key].dotsBtn = dotsBtn; return frame
		end, ri)
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.graph = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local refs = W.makeGraphRow(d.key, nil); refs.frame.Parent = p; r[d.key] = refs; return refs.frame
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.color = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local refs = W.makeColorRow(d.key, nil); refs.frame.Parent = p; r[d.key] = refs; return refs.frame
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	-- Every row builder exposes the row Frame as r[d.key].row so callers can
	-- show/hide a row without walking the brittle `widget.Parent.Parent.Visible` chain  -  that
	-- chain breaks if anyone ever inserts an extra wrapper layer between the widget and the row.
	-- W.makeRow returns the row Frame as its first return value; we capture and store it.
	ROW_BUILDERS.input = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local tb, frame = W.makeInput(d.key, nil, d.default or "0", d.placeholder)
			frame.Parent = p
			r[d.key].input = tb
			return frame
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.toggle = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local tog, wrap = W.makeToggleInBlob(d.key.."Toggle", nil)
			wrap.Parent = p
			r[d.key].toggle = tog
			return wrap
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.dropdown = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local btn, frame, soc = W.makeDropdown(d.key, nil, d.options, d.default)
			frame.Parent = p
			r[d.key].dropdown = btn
			r[d.key].setOnChanged = soc
			return frame
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.expandable_select = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		local ac = {}; for _, a in ipairs({"X","Y","Z"}) do
			table.insert(ac, {key=d.key..a, label=a, builder=function(p,i) return W.makeAxisGraphRow(p,a,T["Axis"..a],i,true) end})
		end
		local _, elems, batchBtn, getChecked = W.makeExpandable(sb, d.label, ac, ri, true)
		for _, a in ipairs({"X","Y","Z"}) do r[d.key..a] = elems[d.key..a] end
		r[d.key.."_batchBtn"] = batchBtn; r[d.key.."_getChecked"] = getChecked
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.expandable_input = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		local ac = {}; for _, a in ipairs({"X","Y","Z"}) do
			table.insert(ac, {key=d.key..a, label=a, builder=function(p,i) return W.makeAxisInputRow(p,a,T["Axis"..a],i,d.placeholder) end})
		end
		local _, elems = W.makeExpandable(sb, d.label, ac, ri)
		for _, a in ipairs({"X","Y","Z"}) do r[d.key..a] = elems[d.key..a] end
	end
	-- Adds a small `*` config-icon button to the row's LabelBlob and stores it on the row's ref
	-- table. Caller (PropertyInputs / Connectors) wires the click via Connectors.cConfigButton.
	-- Shared between path rows and axis rows so any `config={...}` row gets a clickable gear.
	local function addConfigCog(refTable, rowFrame, d)
		if not d.config then return end
		local labelBlob = rowFrame:FindFirstChild("LabelBlob")
		if not labelBlob then return end
		local cog = Instance.new("TextButton"); cog.Name = d.key .. "ConfigBtn"
		cog.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; cog.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		cog.Text = "*"; cog.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; cog.Font = T.Font; cog.TextSize = 11
		cog.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16); cog.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		cog.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0); cog.BorderSizePixel = 0
		cog.Parent = labelBlob
		addCorner(cog, UDim.new(0, 3))
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, cog)
		local labelInst = labelBlob:FindFirstChild("Label")
		if labelInst then
			labelInst.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 0); labelInst.Size = UDim2.new(1, -22, 1, 0)
			W.fitRowLabel(labelInst, LAYOUT.LabelWidth - 22)
		end
		refTable.configBtn = cog
		refTable.configKind = d.config
	end

	local function buildInlineAxis(r, sb, d, ri, maker)
		local axes = d.axes or {"X","Y","Z"}
		-- evenAttrs travels via the row's config table (the same place axis-link metadata
		-- lives) since both features extend the axis-input row in tandem. Only the value-
		-- input maker (makeInlineAxisInput) consumes it; passing through to graph_select /
		-- axis_select is a no-op since those don't read the 6th arg.
		local evenAttrs = d.config and d.config.evenAttrs or nil
		W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local refs = maker(p, d.key, axes, ri, d.placeholder, evenAttrs)
			refs.row.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); refs.row.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); r[d.key] = refs
			addConfigCog(r[d.key], p, d)
			return refs.row
		end, ri)
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.axis_select = function(r, sb, d, ri) buildInlineAxis(r, sb, d, ri, W.makeInlineAxisSelect) end
	ROW_BUILDERS.axis_graph_select = function(r, sb, d, ri) buildInlineAxis(r, sb, d, ri, W.makeInlineAxisGraphSelect) end
	ROW_BUILDERS.axis_input = function(r, sb, d, ri) buildInlineAxis(r, sb, d, ri, W.makeInlineAxisInput) end
	ROW_BUILDERS.link_axes = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local refs = W.makeInlineAxisToggle(p, d.key, d.groups)
			r[d.key] = refs
			return refs.frame
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.toggle_group = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}; W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local tog, wrap = W.makeToggleInBlob(d.key.."Toggle", nil); wrap.Parent = p; r[d.key].toggle = tog; return wrap
		end, ri)
		if d.children then
			local cf = Instance.new("Frame"); cf.Name = d.key.."Fields"; cf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			cf.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); cf.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; cf.LayoutOrder = ri + 100
			cf.Parent = sb; addListLayout(cf, 3); r[d.key].fields = cf
			for ci, cDef in ipairs(d.children) do
				local cb = ROW_BUILDERS[cDef.type]
				if cb then cb(r, cf, cDef, ci) end
			end
		end
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.path = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}
		-- Expose .row like input/toggle/dropdown so mode-driven visibility gating
		-- (Lightning TargetMode) can hide picker rows.
		r[d.key].row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local lbl, frame = W.makePathLabel(d.key, nil); frame.Parent = p; r[d.key].label = lbl
			addConfigCog(r[d.key], p, d)
			return frame
		end, ri)
	end
	-- A row of buttons that do something to the selection: d.buttons = { { key, text }, ... }.
	-- r[d.key].buttons[key] is each button; the section's own wiring connects them.
	ROW_BUILDERS.buttons = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = { buttons = {} }
		local count = #d.buttons
		local gap = 4
		local row = W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
			holder.Name = d.key
			holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			holder.Parent = p
			addListLayout(holder, gap, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
			for index, spec in ipairs(d.buttons) do
				local button = W.makeButton(d.key .. spec.key, holder, spec.text, UDim2.new(1 / count, -gap * (count - 1) / count, 1, 0))
				button.LayoutOrder = index
				r[d.key].buttons[spec.key] = button
			end
			return holder
		end, ri)
		r[d.key].row = row
	end
	ROW_BUILDERS.wip = function(r, sb, d, ri)
		r[d.key] = {}; W.makeRow(sb, d.label, function(p)
			local f = W.makeBlob(d.key.."Wip", nil, UDim2.new(1,-LAYOUT.ContentOffset,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight))
			local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; lbl.Text = "WIP"
			lbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 9
			lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center; lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); lbl.Parent = f
			f.Parent = p; return f
		end, ri)
	end

	function W.buildTypeSection(scrollParent, typeName, propDefs, order)
		local typeContainer, typeBody = W.makeSection(scrollParent, typeName, TYPE_ORDER[typeName] or order, false, typeName, 1)
		local r = {}
		-- Display order comes from PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK; the defs array order only decides
		-- the relative order of sections the rank table does not name.
		for si, secDef in ipairs(propDefs) do
			local _, secBody = W.makeSection(typeBody, secDef.name, PropertyCatalog.sectionRank(secDef.name, si), secDef.collapsed, typeName .. "/" .. secDef.name)
			for ri, rowDef in ipairs(secDef.rows) do
				local builder = ROW_BUILDERS[rowDef.type]
				if builder then builder(r, secBody, rowDef, ri) end
				-- Path and axis rows add their asterisk while they build; any other row with a
				-- `config` gets it here, on the row frame its builder stored.
				local built = r[rowDef.key]
				if rowDef.config and type(built) == "table" and built.row and not built.configBtn then
					addConfigCog(built, built.row, rowDef)
				end
				BuildPacer.step()
			end
		end
		return typeContainer, r
	end
end

--[[
	UIWidgets  -  Part-Icles V5
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle
	Reusable widget factories, theme tracking, drag/snap system.
	Requires UIBuilderConstants for T and LAYOUT references.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Parent.PropertyCatalog)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local Widgets = {}

-- Themed element tracking (cleared on reset)
-- axisColored  -  list of {inst, axisName} for non-button elements (e.g. checkmarks,
-- strokes inside axis rows) that follow the AxisX/Y/Z theme colors. Refreshed by
-- UpdateTheme.
-- evenDots: list of EvenDistribution per-axis dot buttons that follow T.BrightGold
-- (on) / T.DarkGold (off) based on `_even` attribute. Without theme registration,
-- theme edits leave the dots stuck on initial-time colors until the next
-- selection-change refresh.
local _themed = { panels = {}, strokes = {}, fills = {}, blobs = {}, texts = {}, scrollbars = {}, toggles = {}, axisButtons = {}, axisColored = {}, panelImages = {}, evenDots = {}, repaints = {}, roles = {} }
local _uisConnections = {}
local _allPanels = {}

function Widgets.reset()
	for _, conn in ipairs(_uisConnections) do conn:Disconnect() end
	_uisConnections = {}
	_themed = { panels = {}, strokes = {}, fills = {}, blobs = {}, texts = {}, scrollbars = {}, toggles = {}, axisButtons = {}, axisColored = {}, panelImages = {}, evenDots = {}, repaints = {}, roles = {} }
	_allPanels = {}
	Widgets.clearRowHover()
	if Widgets.resetDragState then Widgets.resetDragState() end
end

function Widgets.getThemed() return _themed end
function Widgets.getAllPanels() return _allPanels end
function Widgets.getUISConnections() return _uisConnections end

-- =========================================================
-- LOW-LEVEL HELPERS
-- =========================================================
function Widgets.addCorner(p, r) local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = r or T.Corner; c.Parent = p; return c end
function Widgets.addStroke(p) local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color = T.Border; s.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha; s.Thickness = 1; s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Parent = p; table.insert(_themed.strokes, s); return s end
function Widgets.addPadding(p, l, r, t, b) local pd = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pd.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,l or 6); pd.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,r or 6); pd.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,t or 6); pd.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,b or 6); pd.Parent = p; return pd end
function Widgets.addListLayout(p, pad, dir, hA) local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); l.Padding = UDim.new(0,pad or 4); l.FillDirection = dir or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical; l.HorizontalAlignment = hA or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left; l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; l.Parent = p; return l end

-- Decorative full-bleed background image for a panel. ZIndex=0 sits behind every default-
-- ZIndex sibling under the global Sibling ZIndexBehavior. Image + ImageTransparency driven by
-- T.BgImage / T.BgImageTransparency through UpdateTheme; the live ImageLabel is registered in
-- _themed.panelImages so theme refresh can reapply both fields on each change.
--
-- AutomaticSize panels (Settings, Properties, Theme Editor, HUD) can't host the ImageLabel
-- as a child with Size.Y.Scale=1 because UIListLayout's AbsoluteContentSize sums children's
-- AbsoluteSize.Y, AutomaticSize.Y grows the panel to that sum, ImageLabel grows with it,
-- AbsoluteContentSize grows again  -  divergent every frame. Park the ImageLabel as a SIBLING
-- of the panel inside the same ScreenGui ancestor and mirror Position / Size / Visible via
-- property-changed signals. UIScale on the ScreenGui scales render-time, so we divide the
-- absolute pixel coords by `_getScale(panel)` to keep overlay pixel-accurate.
-- `shape` (default: the panel) is the frame the image lies under, for a panel whose visible
-- frame is smaller than its own rectangle (the graph window: a frame with a tab above it).
function Widgets.attachPanelBackground(panel, shape)
	shape = shape or panel
	-- Sibling overlay for ALL panels  -  never a child of the panel. Reasons:
	--   - Panels with UIListLayout would lay out the child ImageLabel into a layout slot,
	--     and AnchorPoint=(0.5,0.5)+Size=(1,0,1,0) would render half outside the panel.
	--   - AutomaticSize.Y panels would feedback-loop with a Size.Y.Scale=1 child.
	-- Park the overlay at the ScreenGui ancestor; mirror Position / Size / Visible via
	-- property-changed signals. UIScale.Scale divides absolute coords so the overlay
	-- stays pixel-aligned with the panel underneath.
	local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	img.Name = "PanelBackgroundImage"
	img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	img.BorderSizePixel = 0
	img.ZIndex = 0
	img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	img.Image = T.BgImage or ""
	img.ImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency or 1
	img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	img.Visible = panel.Visible
	-- Match the panel's rounded corners so the overlay doesn't render as a square past
	-- the panel's UICorner edges. Read the panel's own UICorner radius if present, else
	-- default to BigCorner (most panels use BigCorner).
	local panelCorner = shape:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	local imgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	imgCorner.CornerRadius = panelCorner and panelCorner.CornerRadius or T.BigCorner
	imgCorner.Parent = img
	local function sync()
		if not panel.Parent then img.Visible = false; return end
		local sg = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not sg then img.Visible = false; return end
		if img.Parent ~= sg then img.Parent = sg end
		local us = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
		local sc = (us and us.Scale ~= 0) and us.Scale or 1
		img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(shape.AbsolutePosition.X / sc, shape.AbsolutePosition.Y / sc)
		img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(shape.AbsoluteSize.X / sc, shape.AbsoluteSize.Y / sc)
		img.Visible = panel.Visible
	end
	img.Parent = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") or panel.Parent or panel
	sync()
	table.insert(_uisConnections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_uisConnections, shape:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_uisConnections, shape:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_uisConnections, panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(sync))
	table.insert(_themed.panelImages, img)
	-- PanelStack keeps the image one layer under its panel as panels come to the front.
	Widgets.linkPanelBackground(panel, img)
	return img
end
-- Alias kept so any consumer using the panel-as-ImageLabel-style call still resolves.
Widgets.applyPanelBackground = Widgets.attachPanelBackground

-- Shortcuts for local use
local addCorner, addStroke, addListLayout = Widgets.addCorner, Widgets.addStroke, Widgets.addListLayout

-- =========================================================
-- WIDGET FACTORIES
-- =========================================================

-- Paints inst[prop] from a colour role now and again on every theme change (ThemeApply).
function Widgets.paint(inst, prop, role)
	inst[prop] = T[role]
	table.insert(_themed.roles, { inst = inst, prop = prop, role = role })
end

-- Field surface: the filled box behind inputs, dropdowns and buttons.
function Widgets.makeBlob(name, parent, size)
	local blob = Instance.new("Frame")
	blob.Name = name
	blob.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	blob.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	blob.BorderSizePixel = 0
	blob.Size = size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
	if parent then
		blob.Parent = parent
	end
	addCorner(blob)
	addStroke(blob)
	table.insert(_themed.blobs, blob)
	return blob
end

function Widgets.makeLabel(name, parent, text, color, font, sz)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.Name = name; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color or T.Gold; l.Font = font or T.Font; l.TextSize = sz or 11
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; l.Size = UDim2.new(1,-6,1,0); l.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0)
	l.BorderSizePixel = 0; l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	if parent then l.Parent = parent end; return l
end

-- Value text inside a field, inset by the field padding and `rightInset` on the right.
local function makeFieldBox(name, field, text, leftInset, rightInset)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Name = name
	box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	box.Text = text
	box.PlaceholderText = ""
	box.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	box.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	box.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftInset, 0, 0)
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(leftInset + rightInset), 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(box, "Number")
	box.Parent = field
	return box
end

function Widgets.makeInput(name, parent, defaultText, placeholder)
	local field = Widgets.makeBlob(name .. "Wrap", parent, UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row))
	local box = makeFieldBox(name, field, defaultText or "0", LAYOUT.FieldPad, LAYOUT.FieldPad)
	box.PlaceholderText = placeholder or ""
	Widgets.wireFieldStates(field, box)
	return box, field
end

function Widgets.makeButton(name, parent, text, size, color)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name = name; b.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; b.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	b.Text = text; b.TextColor3 = color or T.Gold; b.Font = T.Font; b.TextSize = 11
	b.Size = size or UDim2.new(0,50,0,28); b.BorderSizePixel = 0; b.AutoButtonColor = true
	if parent then b.Parent = parent end; addCorner(b); addStroke(b); table.insert(_themed.blobs, b); return b
end

-- The "more" button at the right end of a field.
local function makeDotsButton(field, glyph)
	local dots = Instance.new("TextButton")
	dots.Name = "DotsBtn"
	dots.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	dots.Text = glyph
	dots.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
	dots.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 0, 0)
	dots.ZIndex = 3
	TypeScale.style(dots, "Glyph")
	dots.Parent = field
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		dots.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		return dots
	end
	dots.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	dots.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if Widgets.pointerBlocked(dots) then return end
		dots.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	end)
	dots.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		dots.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	end)
	return dots
end

function Widgets.makeSelectButton(name, parent, axisColor)
	local field = Widgets.makeBlob(name .. "Select", parent, UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row))
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "SelectLabel"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "Edit"
	label.TextColor3 = axisColor or T.MutedGold
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(label, "Value")
	label.Parent = field

	local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
	click.Name = "ClickArea"
	click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	click.Text = ""
	click.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
	click.Parent = field

	local dots = makeDotsButton(field, "\u{22EE}")
	Widgets.wireFieldStates(field)
	return click, field, label, dots
end

-- Graph row: [value] [more]  -  for NumberSequence properties.
function Widgets.makeGraphRow(name, parent)
	local field = Widgets.makeBlob(name .. "Graph", parent, UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row))
	local box = makeFieldBox(name .. "Input", field, "0", LAYOUT.FieldPad, LAYOUT.IconSlot)
	local dots = makeDotsButton(field, "\u{22EF}")
	Widgets.wireFieldStates(field, box)
	return { input = box, dotsBtn = dots, frame = field }
end

-- Distance from the field edge to the colour swatch, and from the swatch to the value.
local SWATCH_INSET = 4
local SWATCH_GAP = 4

-- Colour row: [swatch] [value] [more]  -  for ColorSequence properties.
function Widgets.makeColorRow(name, parent)
	local field = Widgets.makeBlob(name .. "Color", parent, UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row))

	local swatch = Instance.new("Frame")
	swatch.Name = "Swatch"
	swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
	swatch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	swatch.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.Swatch, 0, LAYOUT.Swatch)
	swatch.Position = UDim2.new(0, SWATCH_INSET, 0.5, 0)
	swatch.ZIndex = 2
	-- A user colour: the theme's colour-matching pass must not repaint it.
	swatch:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	swatch.Parent = field
	addCorner(swatch, UDim.new(0, 3))
	if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		-- Keeps a swatch visible when its colour is close to the field's (white on a light theme).
		addStroke(swatch)
	end

	local swatchButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	swatchButton.Name = "SwatchBtn"
	swatchButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	swatchButton.Text = ""
	swatchButton.AnchorPoint = swatch.AnchorPoint
	swatchButton.Size = swatch.Size
	swatchButton.Position = swatch.Position
	swatchButton.ZIndex = 3
	swatchButton.Parent = field

	local textInset = SWATCH_INSET + LAYOUT.Swatch + SWATCH_GAP
	local box = makeFieldBox(name .. "Input", field, "255, 255, 255", textInset, LAYOUT.IconSlot)
	local dots = makeDotsButton(field, "\u{22EF}")
	Widgets.wireFieldStates(field, box)
	return { swatch = swatch, swatchBtn = swatchButton, input = box, dotsBtn = dots, frame = field }
end

-- =========================================================
-- PANEL TRACKING / DRAG / SNAP
-- =========================================================
function Widgets.registerPanel(panel)
	table.insert(_allPanels, panel)
end

local function _getScale(i) local sg = i:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	if sg then local us = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if us then return us.Scale end end; return 1 end

-- Panels overlap freely. Only auto-correction is the viewport clamp below which keeps
-- panels reachable when dragged off-screen. `_allPanels` + `_noSnap` attributes are
-- reserved for future opt-out / scale helpers; neither suppresses the clamp.
-- Settings "Snap Panels In View" toggle drives EdgeSnapEnabled (QOLWiring hydrates it).
Widgets.EdgeSnapEnabled = true
function Widgets.resolveOverlap(panel, _depth, _vp)
	if Widgets.EdgeSnapEnabled == false then return end
	if not panel.Visible then return end
	-- Modules/Workspaces parks a panel off-screen on purpose; clamping would pull it back.
	if panel:GetAttribute("_workspaceParked") then return end
	local scale = _getScale(panel)
	local vp = _vp or (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080))
	local pw, ph = panel.AbsoluteSize.X, panel.AbsoluteSize.Y
	-- Clamp to viewport  -  keeps panels reachable even when dragged off-screen.
	local vpS = vp / scale
	local aX, aY = panel.AbsolutePosition.X / scale, panel.AbsolutePosition.Y / scale
	local cX = math.clamp(aX, 0, math.max(vpS.X - pw/scale, 0))
	local cY = math.clamp(aY, 0, math.max(vpS.Y - ph/scale, 0))
	if math.abs(cX-aX) > 1 or math.abs(cY-aY) > 1 then local p = panel.Position
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset+(cX-aX), p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset+(cY-aY)) end
end

-- handle: one GuiObject, or a list of them that all move the frame.
-- canStart (optional): a press begins a drag only while it returns true.
function Widgets.makeDraggable(frame, handle, canStart)
	local isList = type(handle) == "table" and rawget(handle, 1) ~= nil
	local handles = isList and handle or { handle }
	local dragging = false
	local ds, sp, dragScale
	for _, grip in ipairs(handles) do
		grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				if canStart and not canStart() then
					return
				end
				dragging = true; ds = i.Position; sp = frame.Position; dragScale = _getScale(frame)
				Widgets.raisePanel(frame)
			end
		end)
		grip.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				dragging = false
				task.defer(function() Widgets.resolveOverlap(frame) end)
			end
		end)
	end
	local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			-- A panel moved by hand is the newcomer the panels under it give way to (PanelPush).
			Widgets.panelArrived(frame)
			local d = i.Position - ds
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X / dragScale, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y / dragScale)
		end
	end)
	local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
			task.defer(function() Widgets.resolveOverlap(frame) end)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(_uisConnections, c1); table.insert(_uisConnections, c2)
end

local LABEL_MEASURE_BOUNDS = Vector2.new(10000, 100)

-- A row label too long for `width` drops to the small label size and wraps onto two lines.
-- Classic truncates such a label, as it always has.
function Widgets.fitRowLabel(label, width)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return
	end
	local needed = TextService:GetTextSize(label.Text, LAYOUT.Text, Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium, LABEL_MEASURE_BOUNDS).X
	if needed <= width then
		return
	end
	TypeScale.style(label, "LabelSmall")
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.LineHeight = 0.9
end

function Widgets.makeRow(parent, labelText, contentBuilder, order)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = labelText:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Row"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
	row.LayoutOrder = order or 0
	row.Parent = parent

	-- The label's frame is named LabelBlob in every mode: QOLSearch and the config cog look it up.
	-- Classic fills it as a box; the other modes leave the label plain.
	local label
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		local labelBlob = Widgets.makeBlob("LabelBlob", row, UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.LabelWidth, 1, 0))
		label = Widgets.makeLabel("Label", labelBlob, labelText, T.MutedGold)
	else
		local labelHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
		labelHolder.Name = "LabelBlob"
		labelHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		labelHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.RowIndent, 0, 0)
		labelHolder.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.LabelWidth, 1, 0)
		labelHolder.Parent = row
		label = Widgets.makeLabel("Label", labelHolder, labelText, T.MutedGold)
		label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	end
	TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
	Widgets.fitRowLabel(label, LAYOUT.LabelWidth)
	if C.MODE.Structure.RowHover then
		Widgets.wireRowHover(row, label)
	end

	local content = contentBuilder(row)
	if content and content:IsA("GuiObject") then
		content.Position = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, 0)
		content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 1, 0)
	end
	return row, content
end

-- Collapsible list section: an "Add" button above a vertically-stacked list frame that a
-- populate routine rebuilds per selection (Blender states, Decal layers). Returns
-- (section, addBtn, list). Section order comes from PropertyCatalog.SECTION_RANK.
function Widgets.makeListBox(body, title, addLabel, btnName, listName)
	local section, sectionBody = Widgets.makeSection(body, title, PropertyCatalog.sectionRank(title), true)
	local addBtn = Widgets.makeButton(btnName, sectionBody, addLabel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,20), T.MutedGold); addBtn.TextSize = 9; addBtn.LayoutOrder = 0
	local sl = Instance.new("Frame"); sl.Name = listName; sl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	sl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); sl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; sl.LayoutOrder = 1; sl.Parent = sectionBody; Widgets.addListLayout(sl, 3)
	return section, addBtn, sl
end

function Widgets.makeBlenderBox(body, btnName, stateListName)
	return Widgets.makeListBox(body, "Blender", "+ Add State", btnName, stateListName)
end

-- enableTextScaling removed: professional tool UIs use fixed text sizes.
-- Panel resizing changes input/content width, not font size. Overflow
-- handled by TextTruncate + minimum panel widths in makeResizable.

-- panel -> { width, height }: how small a resize by hand may make it.
local resizeMinimums = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- Replaces a resizable panel's minimum width and / or height. A value may be a function, asked
-- when a resize starts: a floor that depends on what the panel holds (WidgetDeck's tabs).
function Widgets.setResizeMinimum(panel, minW, minH)
	local minimum = resizeMinimums[panel]
	if not minimum then
		return
	end
	minimum.width = minW or minimum.width
	minimum.height = minH or minimum.height
end

local function resolveMinimum(value)
	if type(value) == "function" then
		return value()
	end
	return value
end

-- EDGE RESIZE (hover edge → inner glow → drag to resize)
-- options.topInset: how far under the panel's top its visible frame starts (a panel with a tab
-- above its frame). The top handle and the side handles then follow the frame, not the panel's rectangle.
-- options.grabMoves: an edge pressed before its glow shows moves the panel, for a panel whose
-- frame is what it is held by. Once the glow shows, a press resizes as everywhere else.
function Widgets.makeResizable(panel, minW, minH, options)
	minW = minW or 80; minH = minH or 60
	resizeMinimums[panel] = { width = minW, height = minH }
	local topInset = options and options.topInset or 0
	local grabMoves = options ~= nil and options.grabMoves == true
	local EDGE_W = 12; local HOVER_DELAY = 0.4; local CR = T.BigCorner.Offset
	local GLOW_W = 6
	local GLOW_ROTATION = { L = 0, R = 180, T = 90, B = 270 }
	-- Handles reach HW into the content area.
	local HW = EDGE_W / 2
	local fadeIn = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local fadeOut = TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	-- Handles are children of the panel, so they sit inside its UIPadding. With padding wider than
	-- half a handle they move out by the difference, staying against the panel's real edge.
	local padding = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	local function reach(side)
		return math.max(0, (padding and padding["Padding" .. side].Offset or 0) - HW)
	end
	local edges = {
		{name="R", size=UDim2.new(0,EDGE_W,1,-topInset), pos=UDim2.new(1,-HW + reach("Right"),0,topInset), ax="x", dir=1},
		{name="L", size=UDim2.new(0,EDGE_W,1,-topInset), pos=UDim2.new(0,-HW - reach("Left"),0,topInset), ax="x", dir=-1, moveAxis=true},
		{name="B", size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,EDGE_W), pos=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-HW + reach("Bottom")), ax="y", dir=1},
		{name="T", size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,EDGE_W), pos=UDim2.new(0,0,0,topInset - HW - reach("Top")), ax="y", dir=-1, moveAxis=true},
	}
	for _, edge in ipairs(edges) do
		local handle = Instance.new("TextButton"); handle.Name = "Edge_"..edge.name
		handle.BackgroundTransparency = 1; handle.Text = ""; handle.Size = edge.size
		handle.Position = edge.pos; handle.ZIndex = 8; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		handle.AutoButtonColor = false; handle.Parent = panel
		-- Inner glow along the hovered edge: lives inside the panel (never over neighbours), inset by
		-- the corner radius, fading inward through a UIGradient. Relative sizing follows moves / resizes.
		local highlight = Instance.new("Frame"); highlight.Name = "EHL_"..edge.name
		highlight.BackgroundColor3 = T.Gold; highlight.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		highlight.BorderSizePixel = 0; highlight.Visible = false; highlight.ZIndex = 50
		highlight.Parent = panel
		local glow = Instance.new("UIGradient"); glow.Rotation = GLOW_ROTATION[edge.name]
		glow.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
		glow.Parent = highlight

		local hoverTimer, activated, resizing = nil, false, false
		-- True while a press that moves the panel is held (options.grabMoves): no glow meanwhile.
		local moving = false
		local startMouse, startSize, startPos, scale, sizeScale

		-- Children sit inside the panel's UIPadding, so the glow backs out of it to reach the true edge.
		local function positionHighlight()
			if not panel.Parent then return end
			local pad = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
			local padL = pad and pad.PaddingLeft.Offset or 0
			local padR = pad and pad.PaddingRight.Offset or 0
			local padT = pad and pad.PaddingTop.Offset or 0
			local padB = pad and pad.PaddingBottom.Offset or 0
			highlight.BackgroundColor3 = T.Gold
			if edge.name == "R" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(1, padR - GLOW_W, 0, topInset + CR - padT); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(0, GLOW_W, 1, padT + padB - CR*2 - topInset)
			elseif edge.name == "L" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(0, -padL, 0, topInset + CR - padT); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(0, GLOW_W, 1, padT + padB - CR*2 - topInset)
			elseif edge.name == "B" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(0, CR - padL, 1, padB - GLOW_W); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(1, padL + padR - CR*2, 0, GLOW_W)
			elseif edge.name == "T" then highlight.Position = UDim2.new(0, CR - padL, 0, topInset - padT); highlight.Size = UDim2.new(1, padL + padR - CR*2, 0, GLOW_W) end
		end

		local function armAfterHover()
			if hoverTimer then
				task.cancel(hoverTimer)
			end
			hoverTimer = task.delay(HOVER_DELAY, function()
				positionHighlight(); highlight.Visible = true; activated = true
				TweenService:Create(highlight, fadeIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.2}):Play()
			end)
		end
		local function pointerOnHandle()
			local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local origin, size = handle.AbsolutePosition, handle.AbsoluteSize
			return mouse.X >= origin.X and mouse.X <= origin.X + size.X and mouse.Y >= origin.Y and mouse.Y <= origin.Y + size.Y
		end
		handle.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if resizing or moving or Widgets.pointerBlocked(handle) then return end
			armAfterHover()
		end)
		handle.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if hoverTimer then task.cancel(hoverTimer); hoverTimer = nil end
			if not resizing then
				activated = false
				local tw = TweenService:Create(highlight, fadeOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}); tw:Play()
				tw.Completed:Once(function() if not activated then highlight.Visible = false end end)
			end
		end)
		handle.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
			if not activated then
				if grabMoves then
					moving = true
					if hoverTimer then
						task.cancel(hoverTimer)
						hoverTimer = nil
					end
				end
				return
			end
			resizing = true; scale = _getScale(panel)
			minW = resolveMinimum(resizeMinimums[panel].width)
			minH = resolveMinimum(resizeMinimums[panel].height)
			-- Size.Offset is rendered through the panel's own UIScale (if any); Position.Offset is not.
			local ownScale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			sizeScale = scale * (ownScale and ownScale.Scale or 1)
			startMouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			startSize = panel.Size; startPos = panel.Position; positionHighlight()
		end)
		local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not resizing or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
			-- As with a drag: a panel resized by hand is the newcomer (PanelPush).
			Widgets.panelArrived(panel)
			local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local dx, dy = (mouse.X - startMouse.X) / sizeScale, (mouse.Y - startMouse.Y) / sizeScale
			local posRatio = sizeScale / scale
			local w, h, px, py = startSize.X.Offset, startSize.Y.Offset, startPos.X.Offset, startPos.Y.Offset
			if edge.ax == "x" then local nW = math.max(minW, w+dx*edge.dir); panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,nW,startSize.Y.Scale,h); if edge.moveAxis then panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,px+(w-nW)*posRatio,startPos.Y.Scale,py) end
			else local nH = math.max(minH, h+dy*edge.dir); panel.Size = UDim2.new(startSize.X.Scale,w,0,nH); if edge.moveAxis then panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,px,startPos.Y.Scale,py+(h-nH)*posRatio) end end
			positionHighlight()
		end)
		local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			-- Let go after a move with the cursor still on the edge: the hover starts over.
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and moving then
				moving = false
				if pointerOnHandle() and not Widgets.pointerBlocked(handle) then
					armAfterHover()
				end
			end
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and resizing then
				resizing = false; activated = false
				local tw = TweenService:Create(highlight, fadeOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}); tw:Play()
				tw.Completed:Once(function() highlight.Visible = false end)
				task.defer(function() Widgets.resolveOverlap(panel) end)
				-- Modules/PanelPersistence sets this hook and saves the size along the dragged axis.
				if Widgets.onPanelResized then
					Widgets.onPanelResized(panel, edge.ax)
				end
			end
		end)
		table.insert(_uisConnections, c1); table.insert(_uisConnections, c2)
		if grabMoves then
			Widgets.makeDraggable(panel, handle, function()
				return not activated
			end)
		end
	end
end

local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke, addPadding, addListLayout = W.addCorner, W.addStroke, W.addPadding, W.addListLayout
	-- Call W.getUISConnections() fresh at each site  -  reset() replaces the table.

	-- Read-only path display for EmitParent
	function W.makePathLabel(name, parent)
		local f = W.makeBlob(name.."Wrap", parent, UDim2.new(1,-LAYOUT.ContentOffset,0,LAYOUT.RowHeight))
		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = name; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Text = "none"; lbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 9
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

		if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then

			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2, 1, 0)
		end
		return lbl, f
	end

	-- Shared floating dots menu (created once per Build, repositioned on each open)
	function W.buildDotsMenu(screenGui)
		if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			-- PropertyInputsPE reads the menu's width from its Size and finds "Paste" by name.
			local popup = W.makeMenu(screenGui, "DotsMenu", PanelSizes.get().DotsMenu)
			popup.ZIndex = 20
			return {
				CopyBtn = W.makeMenuItem(popup, "Copy", "Copy graph", 0),
				PasteBtn = W.makeMenuItem(popup, "Paste", "Paste graph", 1),
				ResetBtn = W.makeMenuItem(popup, "Reset", "Reset default", 2),
				Menu = popup,
			}
		end
		local menu = Instance.new("Frame"); menu.Name = "DotsMenu"
		menu.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; menu.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		menu.Size = UDim2.new(0,90,0,0); menu.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		menu.Visible = false; menu.ZIndex = 20; menu.Parent = screenGui
		addCorner(menu, T.Corner); addStroke(menu); addPadding(menu,3,3,3,3); addListLayout(menu, 2)

		local refs = {}
		local function makeMenuItem(name, text, lo)
			local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.Name = name
			btn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; btn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			btn.Text = text; btn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; btn.Font = T.Font; btn.TextSize = 9
			btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,18); btn.BorderSizePixel = 0; btn.LayoutOrder = lo
			btn.AutoButtonColor = true; btn.Parent = menu; addCorner(btn, UDim.new(0,3)); table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, btn)
			return btn
		end
		refs.CopyBtn = makeMenuItem("Copy", "Copy graph", 0)
		refs.PasteBtn = makeMenuItem("Paste", "Paste graph", 1)
		refs.ResetBtn = makeMenuItem("Reset", "Reset default", 2)
		refs.Menu = menu
		return refs
	end

	-- Per-user collapsed state of Properties sections, keyed "<Type>/<Section>" (plugin setting).
	local _sectionStore = {}
	local _sectionPlugin = nil
	function W.loadSectionState(pluginn)
		_sectionPlugin = pluginn
		local ok, saved = pcall(function() return pluginn:GetSetting("PropSectionCollapsed") end)
		_sectionStore = (ok and type(saved) == "table") and saved or {}
	end
	local function saveSectionState()
		if _sectionPlugin then pcall(function() _sectionPlugin:SetSetting("PropSectionCollapsed", _sectionStore) end) end
	end

	-- Line chevron for a collapse arrow. `arrow` keeps its "▼" / "▶" text as state (callers
	-- still write it) but hides it; the chevron turns to match.
	function W.attachChevron(arrow)
		arrow.TextTransparency = 1
		local chevron = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		chevron.Name = "Chevron"
		chevron.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		chevron.Text = "\u{203A}"
		chevron.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(chevron, "Chevron")
		W.paint(chevron, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		chevron.Parent = arrow

		local function turn()
			chevron.Rotation = arrow.Text == "▼" and 90 or 0
		end
		arrow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(turn)
		turn()
		return chevron
	end

	-- Shows the rule above every visible section in `parent` except the first.
	local function refreshRules(parent)
		local sections = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Visible and child:FindFirstChild("TopRule") then
				table.insert(sections, child)
			end
		end
		table.sort(sections, function(first, second)
			return first.LayoutOrder < second.LayoutOrder
		end)
		for index, section in ipairs(sections) do
			section.TopRule.Visible = index > 1
		end
	end

	-- Rule above a section: a line of `thickness` at the top of a spacer `height` tall.
	local function addTopRule(container, parent, thickness, height, role)
		local spacer = Instance.new("Frame")
		spacer.Name = "TopRule"
		spacer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		spacer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
		spacer.LayoutOrder = -1
		spacer.Parent = container

		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Line"
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thickness)
		W.paint(line, "BackgroundColor3", role)
		line.Parent = spacer

		container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			refreshRules(parent)
		end)
		container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LayoutOrder"):Connect(function()
			refreshRules(parent)
		end)
		task.defer(refreshRules, parent)
	end

	-- The Classic section: a filled header box with a triangle arrow, for types and groups alike.
	local function makeClassicSection(parent, sectionName, order, startCollapsed, persistKey)
		local container = Instance.new("Frame")
		container.Name = sectionName:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Section"
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		container.LayoutOrder = order
		container.Parent = parent
		addListLayout(container, 0)

		local head = W.makeBlob("Header", container, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.GroupHead))
		head.LayoutOrder = 0

		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		arrow.Name = "Arrow"
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = startCollapsed and "▶" or "▼"
		arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, 0)
		arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
		TypeScale.style(arrow, "Chevron")
		arrow.Parent = head

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = sectionName
		title.TextColor3 = T.Gold
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 0)
		TypeScale.style(title, "Group")
		title.Parent = head

		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		body.LayoutOrder = 1
		body.Visible = not startCollapsed
		body.Parent = container
		addListLayout(body, LAYOUT.RowGap)
		addPadding(body, 4, 4, 4, 4)

		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		toggle.Name = "Toggle"
		toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		toggle.Text = ""
		toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		toggle.Parent = head
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			body.Visible = not body.Visible
			arrow.Text = body.Visible and "▼" or "▶"
			if persistKey then
				_sectionStore[persistKey] = not body.Visible
				saveSectionState()
			end
		end)
		return container, body, head
	end

	-- Collapsible section. level 1 is a type section (Lightnings, Beams); any other value is a
	-- group inside one. persistKey (optional) makes the collapsed state survive sessions.
	-- Child names Header / Arrow / Title / Toggle / Body are looked up by PropertiesTabs/Pages.
	function W.makeSection(parent, sectionName, order, startCollapsed, persistKey, level)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local structure = C.MODE.Structure
		local isType = level == 1
		if persistKey and _sectionStore[persistKey] ~= nil then
			startCollapsed = _sectionStore[persistKey] == true
		end
		if structure.Classic then
			return makeClassicSection(parent, sectionName, order, startCollapsed, persistKey)
		end

		local container = Instance.new("Frame")
		container.Name = sectionName:gsub("%s+", "") .. "Section"
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		container.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		container.LayoutOrder = order
		container.Parent = parent
		addListLayout(container, 0)

		if isType and structure.TypeRule > 0 then
			addTopRule(container, parent, structure.TypeRule, LAYOUT.TypeGap / 2 + 4, "Rule")
		elseif not isType and structure.GroupDivider then
			addTopRule(container, parent, 1, 1, "Divider")
		end

		local head = Instance.new("Frame")
		head.Name = "Header"
		head.BorderSizePixel = 0
		head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, isType and LAYOUT.TypeHead or LAYOUT.GroupHead)
		head.LayoutOrder = 0
		if isType and structure.TypeHeader == "Band" then
			W.paint(head, "BackgroundColor3", "Band")
			addCorner(head)
		else
			head.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		head.Parent = container

		local chevronLeft = structure.ChevronSide == "Left"
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		arrow.Name = "Arrow"
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = startCollapsed and "▶" or "▼"
		-- A left chevron fills the row indent, so titles and row labels share one left edge.
		local arrowSlot = chevronLeft and LAYOUT.RowIndent or LAYOUT.IconSlot
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, arrowSlot, 1, 0)
		arrow.Position = chevronLeft and UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -arrowSlot, 0, 0)
		arrow.Parent = head
		W.attachChevron(arrow)

		local titleInset = chevronLeft and arrowSlot or 0
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Name = "Title"
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = sectionName
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		title.Position = UDim2.new(0, titleInset, 0, 0)
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
		TypeScale.style(title, isType and "Type" or "Group")
		W.paint(title, "TextColor3", isType and "TextHeading" or "TextPrimary")
		title.Parent = head

		local body = Instance.new("Frame")
		body.Name = "Body"
		body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		body.LayoutOrder = 1
		body.Visible = not startCollapsed
		body.Parent = container
		if isType then
			addListLayout(body, LAYOUT.GroupGap)
			addPadding(body, 0, 0, 4, 0)
		else
			addListLayout(body, LAYOUT.RowGap)
			addPadding(body, 0, 0, LAYOUT.GroupBodyTop, LAYOUT.OpenGroupGap)
		end

		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		toggle.Name = "Toggle"
		toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		toggle.Text = ""
		toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		toggle.Parent = head
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			body.Visible = not body.Visible
			arrow.Text = body.Visible and "▼" or "▶"
			if persistKey then
				_sectionStore[persistKey] = not body.Visible
				saveSectionState()
			end
		end)
		return container, body, head
	end

	function W.makeExpandable(parent, labelText, children, order, hasBatchEdit)
		local outerBlob = W.makeBlob(labelText:gsub("%s+","").."Blob", parent, UDim2.new(1,0,0,0))
		outerBlob.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; outerBlob.LayoutOrder = order or 0

		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame"); wrapper.Name = labelText:gsub("%s+","").."Expandable"
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1; wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
		wrapper.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; wrapper.Parent = outerBlob
		addListLayout(wrapper, LAYOUT.RowGap); addPadding(wrapper, 4, 4, 4, 4)

		local headerRow = Instance.new("Frame"); headerRow.Name = "HeaderRow"; headerRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		headerRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,LAYOUT.Row); headerRow.LayoutOrder = 0; headerRow.Parent = wrapper

		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.Name = "Arrow"; arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		arrow.Text = "▶"; arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; arrow.Font = T.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); arrow.Parent = headerRow

		local lbl = W.makeLabel("Label", headerRow, labelText, T.MutedGold, T.Font, 10)

		local batchBtn = nil
		if hasBatchEdit then
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-82,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
			batchBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); batchBtn.Name = "BatchEdit"
			batchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; batchBtn.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			batchBtn.Text = "Edit Sel."; batchBtn.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold; batchBtn.Font = T.Font; batchBtn.TextSize = 8
			batchBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,64,0,LAYOUT.Row-8); batchBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-66,0,4)
			batchBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; batchBtn.ZIndex = 3; batchBtn.Parent = headerRow
			addCorner(batchBtn, UDim.new(0,4)); addStroke(batchBtn); table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, batchBtn)
		else
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-14,1,0); lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
		end

		-- When hasBatchEdit, batchBtn occupies the right ~50px. clickBtn covers
		-- everything EXCEPT that area (1, -50, 1, 0) so the row header has no
		-- dead-zone where clicks go nowhere.
		local clickBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); clickBtn.Name = "ClickExpand"; clickBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		clickBtn.Text = ""; clickBtn.Size = hasBatchEdit and UDim2.new(1,-70,1,0) or UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); clickBtn.Parent = headerRow

		local subBody = Instance.new("Frame"); subBody.Name = "SubBody"; subBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		subBody.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); subBody.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		subBody.Visible = false; subBody.LayoutOrder = 1; subBody.Parent = wrapper; addListLayout(subBody, LAYOUT.RowGap)

		local elements = {}
		for i, child in ipairs(children) do elements[child.key or child.label] = child.builder(subBody, i) end
		clickBtn.Activated:Connect(function() subBody.Visible = not subBody.Visible; arrow.Text = subBody.Visible and "▼" or "▶" end)

		-- Helper to get checked axes (for batch editing)
		local getCheckedAxes = nil
		if hasBatchEdit then
			getCheckedAxes = function()
				local checked = {}
				for _, child in ipairs(children) do
					local key = child.key or child.label
					local elem = elements[key]
					if elem and elem.row and elem.row:GetAttribute("Checked") then
						table.insert(checked, key)
					end
				end
				return checked
			end
		end

		return outerBlob, elements, batchBtn, getCheckedAxes
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- SLIDER
	-- =========================================================
	function W.makeSlider(parent, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, onChanged, fmt, logScale)
		fmt = fmt or "%.2f"
		local c = Instance.new("Frame"); c.Name = "Slider"; c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		c.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28); c.Parent = parent
		local valLbl = Instance.new("TextBox"); valLbl.Name = "Val"; valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, defaultVal); valLbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		valLbl.Font = T.Font; valLbl.TextSize = 16; valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,16); valLbl.ClearTextOnFocus = false; valLbl.BorderSizePixel = 0; valLbl.Parent = c
		local track = W.makeBlob("Track", c, UDim2.new(1,-4,0,6)); track.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,18)
		local fill = Instance.new("Frame"); fill.Name = "Fill"; fill.BackgroundColor3 = T.SliderFill or Color3.fromRGB(180,60,60)
		fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3; fill.BorderSizePixel = 0; fill.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,0); fill.Parent = track
		addCorner(fill, UDim.new(0,3)); table.insert(W.getThemed().fills, fill)
		local handle = Instance.new("TextButton"); handle.Name = "Handle"
		W.paint(handle, "BackgroundColor3", "BrightGold"); handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		handle.Text = ""; handle.Size = UDim2.new(0,8,0,10); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0,-2)
		handle.BorderSizePixel = 0; handle.Parent = track; addCorner(handle, UDim.new(0,4))
		-- Log-scale helpers (for multiplicative sliders like resize/retime: 0.5x–2x with 1x centered)
		local logRatio = logScale and math.log(maxVal / minVal) or 0
		local function valToAlpha(v)
			if logScale then return math.clamp(math.log(v / minVal) / logRatio, 0, 1) end
			return math.clamp((v - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1)
		end
		local function alphaToVal(a)
			if logScale then return minVal * math.exp(a * logRatio) end
			return minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * a
		end
		local cur = defaultVal
		local function setVal(v, silent)
			cur = v
			local a = valToAlpha(v); fill.Size = UDim2.new(a,0,1,0)
			handle.Position = UDim2.new(a,-4,0,-2); valLbl.Text = string.format(fmt, v)
			if not silent and onChanged then onChanged(v) end
		end
		local dragging = false
		local function upd(input) local ap = track.AbsolutePosition.X; local as = track.AbsoluteSize.X
			if as == 0 then return end; setVal(alphaToVal(math.clamp((input.Position.X-ap)/as,0,1)))
		end
		handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end end)
		handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end)
		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true; upd(i) end end)
		local c1 = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(i) end end)
		local c2 = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end end)
		local uisC = W.getUISConnections(); table.insert(uisC, c1); table.insert(uisC, c2)
		-- Manual text input: allow values outside slider range (negatives + zero too); visual clamps to edges.
		valLbl.FocusLost:Connect(function() local raw = valLbl.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]",""); local n = tonumber(raw); if n then setVal(n) end end)
		setVal(defaultVal, true)
		return c, valLbl, setVal, function() return cur end
	end
	function W.addCollapseButton(header, bodyItems, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton"); arrow.Name = "CollapseArrow"
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; arrow.Text = "▼"; arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
		arrow.Font = T.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8; arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0)
		if not opts.anchorLeft then arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0) end
		arrow.Position = opts.arrowPos or UDim2.new(1,-16,0,0)
		arrow.ZIndex = 3; arrow.Parent = header
		if not C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			-- The same line chevron the section headers use; the text stays as the state.
			arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, LAYOUT.IconSlot, 1, 0)
			W.attachChevron(arrow)
		end
		local expanded = true
		local lastExpandedSize = opts.expandedSize -- track actual size (updated on collapse)
		arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
			expanded = not expanded
			arrow.Text = expanded and "▼" or "▶"
			for _, item in ipairs(bodyItems) do item.Visible = expanded end
			if opts.panel and lastExpandedSize then
				local colW = opts.collapsedSize and opts.collapsedSize.X.Offset or lastExpandedSize.X.Offset
				local colH = opts.collapsedSize and opts.collapsedSize.Y.Offset or 38
				if expanded then
					opts.panel.Size = lastExpandedSize
				else
					-- The size to expand back to: the user's own, not one a push holds it at (PanelPush).
					lastExpandedSize = W.restingSize(opts.panel)
					opts.panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, colW, 0, colH)
				end
				local expH = lastExpandedSize.Y.Offset
				local delta = expH - colH
				-- Keep top edge stable for bottom-anchored panels (AnchorPoint.Y > 0)
				if opts.panel.AnchorPoint.Y > 0 then
					local p = opts.panel.Position
					local shift = expanded and delta or -delta
					opts.panel.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + shift)
				end
			end
		end)
		return arrow
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetSegments  -  the segmented strip: a row of text segments of which some are lit. Used for
	the Inventory's list tabs, group switch and filter tabs, and for the bottom bar's panel
	toggles, so they all look and behave alike.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared W table and adds:
	  W.makeSegmentStrip(parent, name) -> strip        field-coloured, outlined, laid out left to right
	  W.makeSegment(strip, name, text, order, options) -> button
	      options.fill   the segment shares the strip's spare width
	      options.soft   lit is a faint accent tint under bright text instead of a solid fill:
	                     for a strip where several segments are lit at once and only indicate a
	                     state (the bottom bar), where solid fills would outweigh everything else
	  W.paintSegment(button, active)                   lights or dims a segment
	A lit segment is a solid accent fill with on-accent text unless it is soft. An unlit one
	brightens under the cursor (not while something covers it, W.pointerBlocked).
	The lit state is kept here and repainted after a theme change.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

-- How see-through a soft segment's accent tint is.
local SOFT_FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.78

return function(W)
	-- Segment -> lit / under the cursor / soft. Weak keys: segments are destroyed and rebuilt.
	local activeOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local hoveredOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local softOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	-- The themed table the repaint is registered in; a rebuild of the UI makes a new one.
	local registeredIn = nil

	local function paint(segment)
		if activeOf[segment] then
			if softOf[segment] then
				segment.BackgroundTransparency = SOFT_FILL_TRANSPARENCY
				segment.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			else
				segment.BackgroundTransparency = 0
				segment.TextColor3 = T.OnAccent
			end
			return
		end
		segment.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		segment.TextColor3 = hoveredOf[segment] and T.BrightGold or T.DarkGold
	end

	local function repaintAll()
		for segment in pairs(activeOf) do
			paint(segment)
		end
	end

	function W.makeSegmentStrip(parent, name)
		local strip = Instance.new("Frame")
		strip.Name = name
		strip.BorderSizePixel = 0
		W.paint(strip, "BackgroundColor3", "Field")
		strip.Parent = parent
		W.addCorner(strip)
		W.addStroke(strip)
		W.addPadding(strip, 2, 2, 2, 2)
		W.addListLayout(strip, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
		return strip
	end

	function W.makeSegment(strip, name, text, order, options)
		local themed = W.getThemed()
		if registeredIn ~= themed then
			registeredIn = themed
			table.insert(themed.repaints, repaintAll)
		end

		local segment = Instance.new("TextButton")
		segment.Name = name
		segment.Text = text
		segment.AutoButtonColor = false
		segment.BorderSizePixel = 0
		segment.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		segment.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		segment.LayoutOrder = order
		TypeScale.style(segment, "Button")
		W.paint(segment, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
		segment.Parent = strip
		W.addCorner(segment, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(segment, 6, 6, 0, 0)
		if options and options.fill then
			local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
			flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
			flex.Parent = segment
		end

		activeOf[segment] = false
		softOf[segment] = (options and options.soft) or nil
		segment.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if W.pointerBlocked(segment) then
				return
			end
			hoveredOf[segment] = true
			paint(segment)
		end)
		segment.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			hoveredOf[segment] = nil
			paint(segment)
		end)
		paint(segment)
		return segment
	end

	function W.paintSegment(segment, active)
		activeOf[segment] = active == true
		paint(segment)
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetToast  -  transient messages stacked at the bottom right of the plugin's ScreenGui.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared Widgets table and adds setToastParent and
	showToast to it.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Parent.Part.Log)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T

return function(Widgets)
	-- Toast notification system. Used for transient error / info messages that need to
	-- surface to the user without forcing a modal (e.g. "Model has no PrimaryPart").
	-- Stacks vertically in the bottom-right of the plugin's main ScreenGui. Auto-
	-- dismisses after `duration` seconds. Severity controls the accent stripe color:
	-- "info" (gold), "warn" (orange), "error" (red).
	local _toastStack = {} -- active toasts, top of stack = bottom of screen
	local _toastSG -- ScreenGui parent (lazy-initialized once we have ctx)

	-- Set the parent ScreenGui (called once from init.server.lua / UIBuilder).
	function Widgets.setToastParent(sg) _toastSG = sg end

	local TOAST_PAD = 8

	-- Classic's fixed size, or one that holds two lines of the mode's text.
	local function toastSize()
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			return 240, 48
		end
		local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
		return sizes.Toast, sizes.ToastHeight
	end

	local function _repositionToasts()
		local width, height = toastSize()
		for i, toast in ipairs(_toastStack) do
			toast.Position = UDim2.new(1, -width - 16, 1, -16 - i * (height + TOAST_PAD))
		end
	end

	function Widgets.showToast(message, severity, duration)
		if not _toastSG then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] showToast called before setToastParent: " .. tostring(message)); return end
		severity = severity or "info"
		duration = duration or 4
		local accentColor = severity == "error" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 60)
			or severity == "warn" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 150, 60)
			or T.Gold

		local width, height = toastSize()
		local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
		toast.Name = "Toast"; toast.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		toast.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		toast.BorderSizePixel = 0; toast.ZIndex = 50; toast.Parent = _toastSG
		Widgets.addCorner(toast, T.Corner)
		Widgets.addStroke(toast)

		local stripe = Instance.new("Frame"); stripe.Name = "Accent"
		stripe.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0); stripe.BorderSizePixel = 0
		stripe.BackgroundColor3 = accentColor; stripe.ZIndex = 51; stripe.Parent = toast
		Widgets.addCorner(stripe, UDim.new(0, 2))

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Name = "Msg"; lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0); lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
		lbl.Text = tostring(message); lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; lbl.Font = T.Font; lbl.TextSize = 11
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.TextWrapped = true; lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		lbl.ZIndex = 51; lbl.Parent = toast

		table.insert(_toastStack, toast)
		_repositionToasts()

		task.delay(duration, function()
			if toast and toast.Parent then
				for i, t in ipairs(_toastStack) do
					if t == toast then table.remove(_toastStack, i); break end
				end
				pcall(function() toast:Destroy() end)
				_repositionToasts()
			end
		end)
	end
end

--[[
	WidgetToggle  -  the on/off control: a switch or a checkbox, by theme mode.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared Widgets table and adds paintToggle, makeToggle
	and makeToggleInBlob to it.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

return function(Widgets)
	local addCorner, addStroke = Widgets.addCorner, Widgets.addStroke

	-- Distance between the knob and the track edge in a switch.
	local KNOB_INSET = 2

	-- Repaints a toggle from its IsOn and _toggleMixed attributes in the active mode's style.
	-- The mark keeps the name "Dot": a knob Frame in a switch, a tick TextLabel in a checkbox.
	function Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		local mark = toggle:FindFirstChild("Dot")
		if not mark then
			return
		end
		local isOn = toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
		local mixed = toggle:GetAttribute("_toggleMixed") == true
		local stroke = toggle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")

		if mark:IsA("TextLabel") then
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and T.ToggleOn or T.Field
			if stroke then
				stroke.Color = isOn and T.ToggleOn or T.ToggleOff
			end
			mark.TextColor3 = isOn and T.KnobOn or T.TextPrimary
			if mixed then
				mark.Text = "\u{2013}"
			elseif isOn then
				mark.Text = "\u{2713}"
			else
				mark.Text = ""
			end
			return
		end

		if stroke then
			stroke.Color = T.Border
		end
		-- The switch's own size: rows use the mode's switch, older panels a compact one.
		local width = toggle.Size.X.Offset
		local knob = mark.Size.X.Offset
		if mixed then
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = T.ToggleOff
			mark.BackgroundColor3 = T.Warning
			mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, (width - knob) / 2, 0.5, 0)
		elseif isOn then
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = T.ToggleOn
			mark.BackgroundColor3 = T.KnobOn
			mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, width - knob - KNOB_INSET, 0.5, 0)
		else
			toggle.BackgroundColor3 = T.ToggleOff
			mark.BackgroundColor3 = T.KnobOff
			mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, KNOB_INSET, 0.5, 0)
		end
	end

	-- The switch size panels laid out before the theme modes position their toggles for.
	local COMPACT = { Width = 28, Height = 16, Knob = 12 }

	-- On/off control: a switch or a checkbox, by mode. State lives in the IsOn attribute so an
	-- outside SetAttribute repaints it; `_toggleMixed` marks a multi-selection that disagrees.
	-- `roomy` uses the mode's full-size control; without it the toggle keeps the compact size.
	function Widgets.makeToggle(name, parent, roomy)
		local check = C.MODE.Structure.Toggle == "Check"
		local width = roomy and LAYOUT.ToggleWidth or (check and COMPACT.Height or COMPACT.Width)
		local height = roomy and LAYOUT.ToggleHeight or COMPACT.Height
		local knob = roomy and LAYOUT.Knob or COMPACT.Knob
		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
		toggle.Name = name
		toggle.Text = ""
		toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		toggle.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
		toggle.AutoButtonColor = false
		if parent then
			toggle.Parent = parent
		end
		addCorner(toggle, check and UDim.new(0, 4) or UDim.new(1, 0))
		addStroke(toggle)
		table.insert(Widgets.getThemed().toggles, toggle)

		local mark
		if check then
			mark = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			mark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			mark.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			TypeScale.style(mark, "Value")
		else
			mark = Instance.new("Frame")
			mark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
			mark.Size = UDim2.new(0, knob, 0, knob)
			mark.BorderSizePixel = 0
			addCorner(mark, UDim.new(1, 0))
		end
		mark.Name = "Dot"
		mark.Parent = toggle

		toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", false)
		toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
			toggle:SetAttribute("_toggleMixed", nil)
			toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", not (toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true))
		end)
		toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		end)
		toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("_toggleMixed"):Connect(function()
			Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		end)
		Widgets.paintToggle(toggle)
		return toggle
	end

	-- A toggle in a row's value column. Classic boxes it like a field; the other modes use a plain
	-- frame, since a toggle needs no box.
	function Widgets.makeToggleInBlob(name, parent)
		if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
			local blob = Widgets.makeBlob(name .. "Wrap", parent, UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row))
			local boxed = Widgets.makeToggle(name, blob, true)
			boxed.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -LAYOUT.ToggleHeight / 2)
			return boxed, blob
		end
		local wrap = Instance.new("Frame")
		wrap.Name = name .. "Wrap"
		wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.ContentOffset, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
		if parent then
			wrap.Parent = parent
		end
		local toggle = Widgets.makeToggle(name, wrap, true)
		toggle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
		return toggle, wrap
	end
end

--[[
	WorkspaceBar  -  the small bar at the top of the viewport that lists the workspaces of
	Modules/Workspaces: one clickable number per workspace, the active one lit.
	  WorkspaceBar.NAME                      the ScreenGui's name; Workspaces never treats it as a window
	  WorkspaceBar.build() -> ScreenGui      in CoreGui, replacing one an earlier load left behind
	  WorkspaceBar.refresh(gui, count, activeIndex, shown, onPick)
	      rebuilds the numbers in the current theme colours; the bar shows only when `shown`
	      and there is more than one workspace; onPick(index) runs on a click
	Modules/Workspaces owns the ScreenGui and destroys it in stop().
]]

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

-- The shared theme table; UIBuilder:UpdateTheme rewrites its colours in place.
local T = require(script.Parent.Constants).T

local WorkspaceBar = {}

WorkspaceBar.NAME = "PartIclesWorkspaces"

function WorkspaceBar.build()
	local stale = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(WorkspaceBar.NAME)
	if stale then stale:Destroy() end
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = WorkspaceBar.NAME
	gui.DisplayOrder = 50
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Name = "Bar"
	bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 6)
	bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22)
	bar.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Visible = false
	bar.Parent = gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = bar
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
	padding.Parent = bar
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
	layout.Parent = bar
	gui.Parent = CoreGui
	return gui
end

function WorkspaceBar.refresh(gui, count, activeIndex, shown, onPick)
	local bar = gui.Bar
	for _, child in ipairs(bar:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
	end
	bar.Visible = count > 1 and shown
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	for index = 1, count do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = tostring(index)
		button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
		button.Font = index == activeIndex and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham
		button.TextSize = 12
		button.Text = tostring(index)
		button.TextColor3 = index == activeIndex and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
		button.LayoutOrder = index
		button.Parent = bar
		button.Activated:Connect(function() onPick(index) end)
	end
end

return WorkspaceBar
